credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/ghostpipe.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. COILED: one fat waxy stem bent like a question mark, pushing out of violet leaf litter, its furled bud tucked under the hook toward the foe, scale leaves jutting from the stem. Gesture: the hook dips, the bud LIFTS at the foe, sways past upright and droops back. WHITE: ghost pipe has no chlorophyll, so the whole plant is waxy white; the lilac light slot shades the wax and the violet dark slot carries the form and the leaf litter. Sport: the natural pink form.
